image-placeholder.title: Image Placeholder
image-placeholder.description: A Notion-style image placeholder node that lets you upload or embed an image by URL, with a resizable image node view and its own toolbar button.

table.title: Table
table.description: A table node with a toolbar that inserts tables from a grid-size picker, lets you add or delete rows and columns, merge and split cells, toggle the header row, and manage rows and columns from hover context handles. Columns are resizable and a gap cursor is included by default.

mention.title: Mention
mention.description: An @ picker that inserts inline mention nodes with a stable id and label. Items load from a sync or async source with debounce, loading and empty states, and keyboard navigation. Backspace removes the whole mention.

markdown.title: Markdown
markdown.description: Load, store, and paste markdown. Wraps the official Tiptap markdown extension so editor.getMarkdown() and contentType: "markdown" work, adds an opt-in pasteMarkdown option, and ships a toolbar button to import, export, or copy markdown.
